    scores = case['scores']
    budget = case['budget']
    n = len(lengths)

    keep = [[False]*(budget+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
    for i in range(1, n+1):

        s = scores[i-1]
        for w in range(budget+1):

                dp[i][w] = dp[i-1][w-l] + s
                keep[i][w] = True
            else:
                dp[i][w] = dp[i-1][w]
                keep[i][w] = False
    best_score = max(dp[n])
    best_w = None
    for w in range(budget+1):
        if abs(dp[n][w] - best_score) < 1e-9:
            best_w = w
            break

    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        if keep[i][w]:
            selected.append(i-1)
            w -= lengths[i-1]

    tokens_used = sum(lengths[i] for i in selected)
    total_score = sum(scores[i] for i in selected)
    return {
        "selected_indices": selected,
        "tokens_used": tokens_used,
        "total_score": total_score
